{{Top|leg}}
The '''droid neural scrambler''' was a more powerful version of the [[Droid neural pacifier|neural pacifier]]. This device was used in an attempt to overload the victim's neural pathways so as to cause temporary loss of conciousness.

==Behind the scenes==
A [[Droid/Legends|droid]] must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
